implementation: DMD2050E TRANSEC Module FPGA Cryptographic Engine
description: The Comtech EF Data FIPS Security Module features an FPGA to perform bulk encryption/decryption for Ethernet data traffic via the DMD2050E Satellite Modem, as well as firmware to provide the cryptographic functions needed to act as a endpoint for TLS and SSH management and control traffic.
